name: Sugita Kyouka
source: Head of Health Department. Appointed due to her mastery of Medicinal Mahjong after Miiko was suspended for causing too many injuries to the students. Is ordered by the Four Heavenly Kings to obtain Kagami Mao's genetic material to confirm him having the Mahjong Gene.
